input: In support of its goals, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 0.25 percentage point to 3.75 to 4 percent.
source: In support of its goals, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-3/4 to 4 percent.
standard: 委員会は、目標達成に向け、FF金利の誘導目標を0.25パーセントポイント引き下げ、3.75～4％とすることを決定しました。

input: The Committee seeks to achieve maximum employment and inflation at the rate of 2 percent over the longer run.
source: The Committee seeks to achieve maximum employment and inflation at the rate of 2 percent over the longer run.
standard: 本委員会は、長期的に雇用の最大化と2%のインフレ率の達成を目指しています。

input: Longer-term inflation expectations appear to remain well anchored.
source: Longer-term inflation expectations appear to remain well anchored.
standard: 長期的なインフレ期待は、引き続き十分に安定しているようです。

input: Our policy stance is now modestly restrictive, and we are well positioned to respond to developments.
source: Our policy stance is now modestly restrictive, and we are well positioned to respond to developments.
standard: 当行の政策スタンスは現在、緩やかな引き締め的となっており、動向に対応するための十分な態勢を整えております。

input: We cut rates by 25 basis points today.
source: We cut rates by 25 basis points today.
standard: 本日、金利を25ベーシスポイント引き下げました。

input: In the Summary of Economic Projections, the median participant projects two more rate cuts this year.
source: In the Summary of Economic Projections, the median participant projects two more rate cuts this year.
standard: 経済見通し（SEP）において、参加者の中央値は、今年さらに2回の利下げを予想しています。

input: The dot plot is not a plan; it is a collection of individual forecasts.
source: The dot plot is not a plan; it is a collection of individual forecasts.
standard: ドットプロットは計画ではなく、個別の予測をまとめたものです。

input: We decided to slow the pace of balance sheet runoff.
source: We decided to slow the pace of balance sheet runoff.
standard: バランスシートの縮小ペースを緩めることにしました。

input: Quantitative tightening has gone smoothly, and reserves remain ample.
source: Quantitative tightening has gone smoothly, and reserves remain ample.
standard: 量的引き締めは順調に進み、準備預金は依然として潤沢な状態です。

input: Total PCE prices rose 2.8 percent over the 12 months ending in September; excluding the volatile food and energy categories, core PCE prices rose 2.9 percent.
source: Total PCE prices rose 2.8 percent over the 12 months ending in September; excluding the volatile food and energy categories, core PCE prices rose 2.9 percent.
standard: 総合PCE価格は9月までの12カ月間で2.8％上昇しました。変動の激しい食品およびエネルギー部門を除いたコアPCE価格は2.9％上昇しました。

input: We think the neutral rate is probably higher now than it was before the pandemic.
source: We think the neutral rate is probably higher now than it was before the pandemic.
standard: 中立金利は、おそらくパンデミック前よりも現在は高くなっていると考えています。

input: A soft landing is still possible, but it is not assured.
source: A soft landing is still possible, but it is not assured.
standard: ソフトランディングの可能性は依然としてありますが、確実ではありません。

input: We will remain data dependent and make our decisions meeting by meeting.
source: We will remain data dependent and make our decisions meeting by meeting.
standard: 引き続きデータに依拠し、会合ごとに判断を下してまいります。

input: We are not on a preset course.
source: We are not on a preset course.
standard: あらかじめ定められた道筋に沿っているわけではありません。

input: Downside risks to employment have risen, while upside risks to inflation remain.
source: Downside risks to employment have risen, while upside risks to inflation remain.
standard: 雇用への下振れリスクが高まった一方、インフレへの上振れリスクは依然として残っています。

input: Higher tariffs are pushing up prices in some categories of goods.
source: Higher tariffs are pushing up prices in some categories of goods.
standard: 関税の引き上げにより、一部の品目で価格が押し上げられています。

input: Initial jobless claims remain low, and payroll gains have slowed.
source: Initial jobless claims remain low, and payroll gains have slowed.
standard: 新規の失業保険申請件数は低水準にとどまっており、雇用者数の伸びは鈍化しています。

input: The labor market has cooled but remains solid.
source: The labor market has cooled but remains solid.
standard: 労働市場は冷え込んでいますが、依然として堅調です。

input: Governor Waller dissented in favor of a larger cut.
source: Governor Waller dissented in favor of a larger cut.
standard: ウォラー理事は、より大幅な利下げに賛成しました。

input: The Board of Governors also approved a cut in the discount rate.
source: The Board of Governors also approved a cut in the discount rate.
standard: 理事会はまた、公定歩合の引き下げを承認しました。

input: Vice Chair Jefferson spoke about the outlook last week.
source: Vice Chair Jefferson spoke about the outlook last week.
standard: ジェファーソン副議長は先週、見通しについて述べました。

input: The Fed is not behind the curve.
source: The Fed is not behind the curve.
standard: FRBは後手に回っているわけではありません。

input: Headline inflation has come down, but services inflation is still elevated.
source: Headline inflation has come down, but services inflation is still elevated.
standard: 総合インフレ率は低下しましたが、サービスインフレ率は依然として高水準にあります。

input: The Committee will continue to purchase Treasury bills to maintain an ample supply of reserves.
source: The Committee will continue to purchase Treasury bills to maintain an ample supply of reserves.
standard: 委員会は、十分な準備預金を維持するため、引き続き財務省短期証券を買い入れます。

input: The effects of tariffs on inflation could be transitory.
source: The effects of tariffs on inflation could be transitory.
standard: 関税がインフレに及ぼす影響は、一過性にとどまる可能性があります。

input: Thank you, Mr. Chairman. Will the Fed hike rates again this year?
source: Thank you, Mr. Chairman. Will the Fed hike rates again this year?
standard: 議長、ありがとうございます。FRBは今年、再び利上げを行うのでしょうか。

input: Monetary policy works with long and variable lags.
source: Monetary policy works with long and variable lags.
standard: 金融政策は、長期かつ変動的なラグを伴って機能します。

input: Financial conditions have eased since the last FOMC meeting.
source: Financial conditions have eased since the last FOMC meeting.
standard: 前回のFOMC会合以降、金融環境は緩和しています。

input: The federal funds rate is now in a range of 3.75 to 4 percent.
source: The federal funds rate is now in a range of 3.75 to 4 percent.
standard: FF金利は現在、3.75～4％の水準にあります。

input: We lowered the policy rate by a quarter point.
source: We lowered the policy rate by a quarter point.
standard: 政策金利を0.25ポイント引き下げました。

input: Our dual mandate is maximum employment and stable prices.
source: Our dual mandate is maximum employment and stable prices.
standard: 我々の2つの責務は、雇用の最大化と物価の安定です。

input: The mandate was given to us by Congress.
source: The mandate was given to us by Congress.
standard: その責務は議会から私たちに委ねられました。

input: The Federal Reserve remains committed to its price stability goal.
source: The Federal Reserve remains committed to its price stability goal.
standard: 連邦準備制度は、物価の安定という目標に引き続き取り組んでいます。

input: Fed funds futures are pricing in another cut in December.
source: Fed funds futures are pricing in another cut in December.
standard: FF金利先物は、12月のさらなる利下げを織り込んでいます。

input: Chair Powell said the Committee is not in a hurry.
source: Chair Powell said the Committee is not in a hurry.
standard: パウエル議長は、委員会は急いでいないと述べました。

input: Policy is no longer accommodative.
source: Policy is no longer accommodative.
standard: 政策はもはや緩和的ではありません。

input: The SEP shows a median of two cuts next year.
source: The SEP shows a median of two cuts next year.
standard: 経済見通し（SEP）では、来年の利下げ回数の中央値は2回となっています。

input: Looking at the dots, most participants expect rates to be lower next year.
source: Looking at the dots, most participants expect rates to be lower next year.
standard: 点で見ると、ほとんどの参加者が来年の金利は低下すると予想しています。

input: We will end QT on December 1.
source: We will end QT on December 1.
standard: 12月1日をもってQTを終了いたします。

input: The balance sheet has shrunk by more than two trillion dollars.
source: The balance sheet has shrunk by more than two trillion dollars.
standard: バランスシートは2兆ドル以上縮小しました。

input: Some participants favored holding rates steady.
source: Some participants favored holding rates steady.
standard: 一部の参加者は、金利の据え置きを支持しました。

input: We raised rates by 75 basis points in June.
source: We raised rates by 75 basis points in June.
standard: 6月に金利を75ベーシスポイント引き上げました。

input: The FOMC decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 3.75 to 4%.
source: The FOMC decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 3 and 3/4 to 4%.
standard: FOMCは、FF金利の誘導目標を3.75～4%に据え置くことを決定しました。

input: We lowered the target range to 4.25 to 4.5 percent.
source: We lowered the target range to 4 and 1/4 to 4 and 1/2 percent.
standard: 誘導目標を4.25～4.5％に引き下げました。
